title: Incident #4526 — Revenue Report Overcount
scenario: The finance team is alarmed by a revenue report that shows sales inflated by 50%. Investigate the dbt model.
code:
SELECT
    user_id,
    SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
FROM
    orders
WHERE
    order_date >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY
    user_id
HAVING
    total_revenue > 1000;

options.text: The HAVING clause is filtering out too many users.
The SUM function is aggregating over incorrect order amounts.
The date filter is including future dates.
The GROUP BY clause is missing a necessary column.

explanation: The bug lies in how `SUM(amount)` aggregates revenue — it might include refunds or adjustments, leading to inflated totals. To fix this, ensure the query filters out negative amounts before aggregation by adjusting the WHERE clause to `WHERE amount > 0 AND order_date >= '2026-01-01'`.
